items.text: Neyi wakatiyilila chachiwahi mwizu daYehova Nzambi yeyi, hiwakashamuchima wakwila mwalejaŋavi mwejima munukukuleja lelu, wakamona Yehova Nzambi yeyi wakakumotwesha hewulu, wakabadikanyuza yahamaseki yejima.
Ninkisu jejimŋi wakajimona, jakakulondela jakakuwana, neyi wakatiyilila mwizu daYehova Nzambi yeyi.
Wakakoolekanimu mukala, wakakooleka nimwiha.
Nianyaneyi, ninyikabuyaheseki deyi, ninyikabu yakuyimuna yeyi, mwakasemunwinawu aŋombi jeyi nianyana kanyikoku yeyi, yakakooleka hohu.
Nimutoŋa weyi niiyandadeyi dakakooleka.
Wakelaŋa hakwinza wukooleka, hakuya nawa wukooleka.
Ayilumbu jeyi akakunyamukilaŋa Yehova wakayitapisha kumesu eyi; akakulotokelaŋa njila yimu, akakutemuka njila jitanu najiyedi.
Yehova wakakukokela nkisu munkalaŋa jeyi nimuyuma yejima yiwakakwatachikasa; wakakukoolekesha mwitvuja dikukwinka Yehova Nzambi yeyi.
Yehova wakakushimatisha, wakekali muza wajila wakumujilila yena, mwomwakusanyikilihyi; neyi wakahembaŋa mwanakulejiyi Yehova Nzambi yeyi nakwenda munjila jindi.
Nyuza yahamaseki yejima akamona wunatiyakeni dehi ijina daYehova, hiyakakutiya niwoma.
Yehova wakakuvulishila nankashi anyaneyi, nianyana kawayimuna yeyi, ninyikabuyaheseki deyi, mwituŋa dasanyikiliyi Yehova ankakulula jeyi kukwinka.

Yehova wakakujikwilaŋa luhetu lwindi lwaluwahi, dodiwulu, akakwinkaŋa nvula yamwituŋa deyi hachila aka chayu, akakiswila ninyidimu yakuchikasa cheyi yejima nkisu; wakasondamisha nyuza yayivulu, eyi kusondama nehi.
Yehova wakakubalumuna kwikala namutu, bayi mukilaku; wakakumaŋahewulu hohu, eyi kukuma kwishina nehi; neyi wakatiyililaŋa kuleja kwaYehova Nzambi yeyi kunukukuleja lelu nakushaku muchima wakwilamu;
nákubula kuteŋuluka mumazu inukuyileja lelu, nákubula kuya kuchikasa chachidiilu hela kuchimunswa, nákubula kulondela akishi himukuyipesha.
Neyi wakabula kutiyilila mwizu daYehova Nzambi yeyi nákubulakushaku muchima wakwila mwalejaŋayi mwejima niyidika yindi yinukukulejalelu, wakamona mashiŋu ejimawa akakulondela, akakuwana.
Wakashiŋewa mumukala, wakashiŋewa nimwiha.
Nimutoŋa weyiniiyanda deyi dakashiŋewa.
Nianyaneyi, ninyikabu yaheseki deyi, nimwakasemunwinawu aŋombi jeyi nianyana kanyikoku yeyi, akashiŋewa hohu.
Wakela hakwinza wushiŋewa, hakuya nawa wushiŋewa.

Yehova wakakukunkwila ishiŋu, nikukala, nikubaya, muyuma yejima yiwakakwata chikasa yiwakakeŋa kwila, ninichi chiwamba kajilumuka, ninichi chiwamba kanoŋa chakadi nikuleha, nakutama kuwunakoŋi hiwunanlekami.
Yehova wakakulamika chipúpu, ninichi chakakunoŋeshayi ji-i mwituŋa diwukuya nakuheta.
Yehova wakakweta nalunkonka, nayikatu yamashika, nikutotoloka yilonda, ninkanza yasweja, nimpoku yakabali, nikúumisha yuma yejima chau, nimbuwa; yakakuhaŋa haŋe-e ninichichiwakanoŋa.
Iwulu dahanamutu weyi akadumisha chau neyi wuneŋu, iseki damwishina deyi dakakola neyi chikuriu.
Yehova wakabalumuna nvula yamwituŋa deyi yakekala kwalunkuŋu hohu fuku-fuku; yakakuholokela mwiwulu holoke-e ninichi chiwakajilumuka.
Yehova wakakutapisha kumesu awayilumbu jeyi; wakayilotokelanjila yimu, wakayitemuka njila jitanu najiyedi; wakaluluta nakukimboka mwahita mawanta ejima ahamaseki.
Chibimbi cheyi akachidya kudiatujila ejima ahaluzwizu, nikudi anyama ahamaseki, niwakuyitemuna hosi.
Yehova wakakweta nehuti damuEjipitu, natusuŋuhuti, niyilonda, nimukuli, kutwesha kukuuka nehi.
Yehova wakakweta nakuzaluka, nawuputamesu, nimutentu mumuchima.
Wakapapata hakachi kamwaana mwiwulu neyi chapapataŋayi mputamesu mumwidima, hiwakamona kushakama chachiwahuku; akakukabishaŋa nakukubuwabuwa mafuku ejima, niwakakuhandisha kwosi.
Neyi woti mumbanda, iyala wacheŋi hakukama nindi. Neyi wutuŋi itala, kushakamamu nehi. Neyi wudimi itempa danyivinyu, kudidya nehi.
Ŋombi yeyi akakujahilayi kumesu eyi, eyi aweni kumudya nehi. Chimbulu cheyi akakuhukwilayi kumesu eyi, kukufuntishilayi nehi. Nyikokuyeyi akayinka ayilumbu jeyi, hiwakamona wakukuhandishaku.
Anyaneyi amayala nawambanda akayinka antu acheŋi, mesu eyi akatalila talile-e, eyila nibwi nakuyifwila mwaana wejima; hiwakamona nimwakwilaku.
Yakudya yeyi yiwakadima, ninyidimu yeyi yejima, akayidya kudi muza wacheŋi wabula kwiluka. Akakukabisha nakukuchikachika mafuku ejima.
Wakazaluka nayuma yiwakamona namesu eyi.
Yehova wakakweta nimumanuŋu nimunyendu nehuti dakala dakaŋanya nikuuka, kufumisha kumadachilu eyi mujimba wejima ndo nimwishina damutu weyi.
Yehova wakakutwala nineyi nimwanta weyi walukanu iwakadiishamuwanta kudi muza wabulili kwiluka hela eyi hela ankakulula jeyi; kwenokuwakapesha akishi, nyitondu namalola.
Mukachi kanyuza yejima kwakakutwalayi Yehova hiwakekala wakuhayama hohu, wuchishimu, niwakutenamwatama.
Wakela kuya kwiha wakaya nambutu jajivulu, hakukuŋula wakakuŋulajantesha, muloŋa akajidya kudi atubola.
Wakadima matempa anyivinyu, wakachipachipamu, eyi kunwinamu vinyu nehi, hela kudi ilamu nyikabunehi, akayidya kudi atububu.
Wakekala nanyitondu yanyiolive mwahitaŋinza jeyi jejima, kuwaya manji nehi, muloŋa muolive weyi wakahuluka.
Mwenyi wakatuŋa naneyi wakakumotokaŋa ayaŋa kwiwulu hohu, eyi wakayaŋa nakushala mwishina hohu.
Wakakusondamishaŋeyi, eyi kumusondamisha yena nehi. Yena diyi wakekala namutu, eyi wakekalamukila.
Mashipu ejimawa akakuwana, akakuhaŋa, akakukwata, ninichi chiwakajilumuka; muloŋa wabulili kutiyilila mwizu daYehova Nzambi yeyi, wabulili kuhemba nikuleja kwindi, niyidika yindi yakulejeliyi.
Mashiŋuowu wakekala nawu achinjikijilu akuhayamisha nineyi nianyaneyi akekalanawu haya nyaka;
nanochu chiwabulili kumukalakela Yehova Nzambi yeyi namuzaŋalu, nikutiya kuwaha mumuchima weyi, chiyalu mbamini yuma yejima.
Dichi hiwakakalakela ayilumbu jeyi akakutemeshelayi Yehova, wakayikalakela nanzala, nampwila, niwuvu, nikubula yuma yejima; wakakusha mpanda yachikuŋu hanshiŋu yeyi ninichi chakakujilu munayi.
Yehova wakakuletela muza wakwakulehi wakunsa yeseki neyi chatúukaŋambuulu, muza wukweti idimi diwabula kwiluka;
muza womahamesu, wabulaŋa kwakama atushinakaji, hela anyana anyanya kuyitoŋanehi.

Yena wakadya nyana yakasema yimuna yeyi; niyuma yiwakadima, ninichi chiwakajilumuka; hakakushila hoku hela tidiku, hela vinyu, helamanji, hela nyana yakasema aŋombi jeyi, hela nyana kanyikoku yeyi, ninichichakakunoŋeshayi to-o.

Wakakukuchika njita kuyisu yakumpwembu jeyi jejima, ninichichika humuka mpwembu jeyi jajilehi jakuhata jiwakuhweleleli mwahita ituŋa deyi dejima. Wakakukuchika njita kuyisu yampwembu jeyi jejima, mwahita ituŋaŋa deyi dejima danakwinkiyi Yehova Nzambi yeyi.

Wakadyaanyana akudisemena eyi aweni mwivumu deyi, wakadya mbiji yawanyaneyi amayala niawambanda anakwinkiyi Yehova Nzambi yeyi nakukuchikakwaka kukuchikawu, nakukala kwakakukalishawu kudi ayilumbu jeyi.
Neyi wakabula kushaku muchima wakw ila mazu ejima anshimbiji jinasonekuwu mumukandiwu, kulonda ŋinidi dalema dazaalaŋawu woma daYEHOVA Nzambi Yeyi wakaditiyi woma;
Yehova wakakutoheshelayi ipúpuyeyi, antu akahayama hohu, niyipúpu yawanyaneyi, yakela yipúpu yamaneni yakutwalaŋahu hohu, niyikatu yatama yakutwalaŋahu hohu.
Wakakuletela cheŋi nyisoŋu yamuEjipitu yejima yiwatiyilaŋa woma, hiyakakulamata.
Yehova wakakusaŋumwina nawa niyikatu yejima niyipúpu yejima yanabuli kusonekawu mumukanda anshimbiji, ninichi chiwakajilumuka.
Enu mwadiŋi amavulu neyi tutumbwa twamwiwulu mwakashala antesha hohu, nanochu chiwabulili kutiyilila mwizu daYehova Nzambi yeyi.
Mwakamona chatiyilaŋayi Yehova kuwaha nakuyila mwamuwahi nakuyivulisha, dichi chamba katiyayi nawa Yehova kuwaha nakuyinoŋesha nakuyijilumuna; akayihukula mwituŋa dimukuya nakuheta.
Yehova wakakumwaŋa mwa-mwa mwahita nyuza yejima, kufumishakunsa yeseki yimu ndo nikunsa yeseki yi kwawu; kwenoku wakapeshaakishi lwabulili kwiluka hela eyi, hela ankakulula jeyi, anyitondu namalola.
Munyuzoyu hiwakamwena mwoku kunooka, hiwakamona hakunookela idachilu deyuku; Yehova wakakwinka muchima wakulukuma, nimesuakuzeya, nimuchima wakaneŋu,
wakashakama nakululuta hohu; wakatiyaŋakwawoma hohu niwufuku nimwaana, hiwakamona nihawuhandiluku.
Nabudidi wakela neyi, Yayo! hikweyilaŋa hoku! Namelela wakela neyi, Yayo! hikwachaŋa hoku! nawoma wuwakatiya mumuchima weyi, nayumayiwakamona namesu eyi.

Yehova wakakufuntisha cheŋi muEjipitu mumaatu, njila yinakwilili nami, Hiwamba kayimona cheŋuku; kwenoku mwakadilanda kudi ayilumbu jenu mwikali anduŋu amayala nawanduŋu awambanda, hosi niniwu wakayilandaku.
